current_readiness: SOURCE_EXISTS_NOT_CONNECTED; immutable h2h capture implementation is required
identity_matching: Exact normalized home and away identities plus commence_time within 15 minutes of NHL scheduled start; ambiguity fails closed.
immutability: Persist every raw payload and normalized quote append-only. Latest is a derived view, never the only stored state.
missing_side: Preserve available side with INCOMPLETE_TWO_WAY; exclude de-vig and Population B

snapshot_classes.LATEST_BEFORE_CHAMPION_PREDICTION: Maximum valid quote timestamp <= champion run timestamp
snapshot_classes.LATEST_BEFORE_PUCK_DROP: Maximum valid quote/capture timestamp < scheduled start
snapshot_classes.OPENING_OBSERVED: First valid quote observed per game/book

source_candidate: The Odds API through a new mainline-only wrapper; do not alter prop defaults
suspended: Retain event with SUSPENDED status; do not normalize as active quote

timing_rules.stale: Flag when quote age exceeds 30 minutes at associated run; retain but exclude latest-at-run qualification unless no qualified status is claimed
timing_rules.unknown_provider_timestamp: retain raw quote but market_capture_status=TIMING_UNCERTIFIED; exclude Population B
timing_rules.valid_pregame: quote_timestamp_utc and capture_timestamp_utc strictly before scheduled_start_time_utc
